supersession_reason: Pre-outcome adversarial review found epochs/LR/LoRA, repetition-floor and exact allocation policies were not yet fully bound. No Phase-2 model output had been accessed. V1 remains preserved as freeze history; V2 is the sole outcome-authorizing protocol.

training.base_loading: 4-bit NF4 where supported; otherwise exact Phase-1-equivalent quantization only, else RESOURCE_BLOCKED
training.optimizer: AdamW as implemented by the frozen Phase-1 executor
training.final_model_rule: Every arm final checkpoint is trained from the same frozen base on exactly its final 48 selected examples under these identical hyperparameters. C/E intermediate selection checkpoints may be re-trained from the same base on their cumulative selected examples at each round; only the final 48-example checkpoint is used for confirmatory outcomes.

arms.A_UNIFORM_RANDOM: Sample 48 without replacement from the union of six equal-size exposure pools using seed 46601; exposure labels are not used in selection.
arms.B_SEMANTIC_DIVERSITY: Greedy farthest-first selection of 48 prompts using token-set Jaccard distance only, deterministic tie break by case id; no gold, loss, verifier or structural coordinate enters selection.
arms.C_STRONGEST_MODEL_AWARE_PARENT: Six rounds. After each cumulative 8-example increment, train a selection checkpoint from frozen base on the cumulative set; evaluate the six selection-probe groups and choose the next exposure group with highest mean binary-label cross-entropy. No RAKL mastery threshold, safety vector or structural utility scalar is used. First round is uniform 1/coordinate plus two seed-deterministic extras.
arms.D_STATIC_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: Exactly 8 examples from each of the six exposure types, chosen by frozen seed before outcomes; no learner state changes the mix.
arms.E_ADAPTIVE_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: Six rounds. First round is 1/coordinate plus two seed-deterministic extras. Thereafter train/evaluate a cumulative selection checkpoint, form the six-coordinate mastery vector from selection-probe accuracies, preserve one SAME_STRUCTURE slot per 8-example batch, enforce retention <0.80 as priority and never select a coordinate whose registered forgetting/negative-transfer guard has crossed 0.10; otherwise allocate remaining slots to the lowest measured unsaturated coordinate with deterministic coordinate/case-id tie breaks. Principle has priority until >=0.90.

statistics.success_rule: E-D >= 0.05, paired 95% CI lower > 0, Holm-adjusted primary significant, E-C lower CI >= -0.02, and every hard-harm coordinate E-D lower CI > -0.05 after full overhead accounting.
statistics.fixed_stopping: 6 allocation rounds and 48 final examples; no outcome-dependent extension
statistics.invalid_missing: missing/invalid prediction is counted incorrect and retained in resource accounting

resource_envelope.preferred_gpu: A10G or A100 class with sufficient memory for the exact frozen 7B 4-bit+LoRA run
resource_envelope.if_unavailable: RESOURCE_BLOCKED; never substitute a smaller model or change the MDE after inspecting Phase-1 signal

decision_tree.PARENT_MATCHES_OR_BEATS: E-C violates registered noninferiority or C is distinguishably better
decision_tree.STATIC_EQUALS_ADAPTIVE: E-D is precise enough to exclude +0.05 while including 0 and hard harms pass
decision_tree.UNDERPOWERED: CI width/precision does not adjudicate the MDE
decision_tree.RESOURCE_BLOCKED: exact 7B execution unavailable under the frozen envelope
decision_tree.INVALID_CONTAMINATED: any overlap/leakage/post-outcome policy or evaluator mutation

authority_boundary: No result grants scientific/theorem authority. Phase-2 only adjudicates the training-allocation extension; Paper-IV standalone release still requires issue #462 synthesis.
